text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen was a fiercely 
contested race. During the race, Silence 
Suzuka demonstrated a speed that heralded 
the dawn of a new era.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though astonished by a running style so 
unlike a Mejiro, Mejiro Bright seized a 
brand-new turning point.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wishing to leap even higher, the two vowed 
to rematch at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
